title: Make SQLite history version allocation conflict-safe
description: Deep-dive audit 2026-08-08 verified that SqliteMemorySmithDatabase allocates versions using MAX(VersionNumber)+1 without deterministic conflict retry. Concurrent writers can select the same next number and receive SQLITE_BUSY or uniqueness failures. Evidence: MemorySmith.Storage/SqliteMemorySmithDatabase.cs lines 529-532. Serialize allocation or add deterministic retry under an immediate transaction, with concurrent version tests.
